description: Issue severity classification and escalation routing policy

P0.label: Critical
P0.definition: Data breach, secrets leaked, client-facing outage, sandbox escape, integrity tamper detected
agent_action: Revoke all runtime secrets for affected client
Generate forensic snapshot of logs and state

P1.label: High
P1.definition: Client automation silently failing, billing mis-attribution, test suite broken on main, heartbeat failure, config drift detected
agent_action: Open PR with detailed diff and test results
Send Telegram summary with PR link
Log to Kanban under Automated Bug Reports

P2.label: Medium
P2.definition: Code quality regression, missing tests, deprecated dependency, non-critical config drift, documentation gaps
agent_action: Log to Kanban under Automated Bug Reports

P3.label: Low
P3.definition: Style/formatting issues, minor documentation typos, non-blocking warnings, log noise
agent_action: Auto-fix and auto-merge directly to main

fallback: If Telegram is unreachable during P0, retry 3 times at 30s intervals. If still unreachable, write to logs/escalation-failures.jsonl and attempt SMS via configured provider.
